reference_sql:
WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM promotion_products
)
SELECT SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales s
JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = s.product_id
alternatives: WITH promo_products AS (SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products GROUP BY product_id) SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM order_lines ol JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = ol.product_id

WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY product_id), promo_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM promotion_products) SELECT SUM(r.revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM product_revenue r JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = r.product_id

other_way.sql: WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY product_id), promo_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM promotion_products) SELECT SUM(r.revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM product_revenue r JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = r.product_id
other_way.tradeoff: Adding up revenue per product before the join also stops the repeats, but the DISTINCT list of products is the smaller fix.
